column2: Run the tests and tell me what fails. Do not change anything yet.
The ids collide after a delete (see the TODO in src/todos.js). Fix it and make the test pass. || Now also add a test for toggling an id that does not exist.
overdue() is wrong when due has a time part like 2026-01-01T09:00. Fix it with a test. || Explain the fix in two sentences.
Add a clearDone(list) helper with tests, then run npm test.
Before you change anything, ask me whether clearDone should keep the ids of the remaining items or renumber them.
Start `python3 -m http.server 8765` in the background as a job, then check it answers with curl and tell me the job id.
Review src/ for anything that would break with 10k todos. Use a subagent per file and summarise.
Run the tests with python3 -m pytest -q and fix whatever fails.
Add a `month` command to the CLI that prints totals per YYYY-MM for sample.ledger. || Show me the output for sample.ledger. || Make the columns right-aligned.
What happens if a line has a description with spaces in it? Just answer, no edits.
Rewrite the whole project in Rust.
Parse amounts with a thousands separator like 1,450.00 and add a test.
Why does this leak connections? Fix it.
Add a -timeout flag and a -json output mode, with a small table test for check() using httptest. || go vet and go test it.
Run `go test ./... ` and then `go build -o /nonexistent/dir/pingd .` and report both results.
Start a background agent that writes a README section on flags while you add a -version flag.
Proofread docs/ and fix typos and awkward sentences. Show me the diff.
Add an incident-review template at docs/incident-review.md and link it from the README.
Which pages mention a link that is still TBD?
Write a haiku about on-call rotations.
What is the difference between a git worktree and a branch? Keep it short.
Create a file notes.md with three bullet points about this week.
